# routeros_ip_socks (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `auth_method` (String) Authentication method required from the clients.
  * none - no authentication.
  * password - the client must present the credentials of a `/ip/socks/users` entry (SOCKS5 only).
- `connection_idle_timeout` (String) Time after which an idle connection is terminated.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enables the SOCKS proxy.
- `max_connections` (Number) Maximum number of simultaneous connections.
- `port` (Number) TCP port on which the SOCKS server listens for connections.
- `version` (String) SOCKS protocol version served: `4` or `5`.
- `vrf` (String) The VRF table this resource operates on.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
